{'sentence': 'Sally Field and Reba McEntire honoured the late legend Dolly Parton on Monday at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards.'}

{'sentence': '"If there are really angels in this world, I think we lost one just now — Dolly Parton," Sally Field said.'}

{'sentence': '"I was so lucky to have worked with Dolly on a film called \'Steel Magnolias\'," the actress said, as the audience applauded.'}

{'sentence': '"I\'ve loved her for years and from afar. I\'ve been in love with her since the first day — and who wouldn\'t be?" the Oscar winner said. "She was genuine and humble — eager to help, and very funny. She had a raunchy sense of humour that would make those rough-and-tumble big men look for places to hide."'}

{'sentence': '"I didn\'t get to see back then how truly great Dolly really was. She wasn\'t just an artist, she was a great human being. She was a humanitarian, and her contributions had a profound impact on the lives of countless people in her home state of Tennessee and across the country."'}

{'sentence': '"God bless you, Dolly Parton, my friend. You have so many people in this world that love you forever," Field said to thunderous applause.'}

{'sentence': 'McEntire then gave an emotional performance of Parton\'s song "Appalachian Memories".'}

{'sentence': 'The singer\'s nephew shared a video on social media in August announcing Parton\'s death. The family of the \'9 to 5\' actress later confirmed that Parton had died after a "brief battle with cancer".'}
